description: Calculate the Acoustic Breathiness Index (ABI) combining connected speech and sustained vowel. ABI aggregates CPPS, jitter, GNE approximation, HNR (6 kHz), H1-H2, shimmer, and period SD. Sensitive to the full spectrum from breathy to pressed phonation. BEFORE CALLING: (1) Ask for or infer the patient language (en/fr/nl/es/de/it). (2) Show the user the correct connected speech sentence for that language (read vocametrix://recording-guide to get it) and ask them to record it. (3) Confirm they also have a sustained /a/ vowel recording of 5+ s. Only call once both recordings are confirmed ready.

connectedSpeechPath.description: Connected speech WAV file — patient reads the language-specific reference sentence (see vocametrix://recording-guide)

language.description: Patient language — determines the correct connected speech reference sentence
